name: Vassbotten - Håvedalen
routeType: point-to-point official Bohusleden stage; remote border-area stage with asphalt, gravel road, forest path, bare rock, marshy sections, wind-farm uplands and rural road approaches

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: Stage 24 Vassbotten - Håvedalen
keyFacts: Primary official name is 24. Vassbotten - Håvedalen.
West Sweden Trails facts are 19 km, 7-8 h and hard/red.
The stage starts at Vassbotten in Tanums kommun and ends at Håvedalen / Allemarksvägen in Strömstads kommun.
Surface and terrain include asphalt for the first/about 2 km, gravel and dirt road, forest path, bare rock, forest, rocky fields, marshy or uneven parts and rural countryside.

Official description highlights the border-area setting, the Snarsmon traveller settlement at Ejgdefjäll, Ejgdesjön, Ekelidsvattnet, Tolvmanstegen, wind-farm high ground and Håvedalen/Alemark shelter near the end.
West Sweden Trails provides official map/API linework and an official Hoodin GPX with 2748 raw points.
Official point layer includes bus stops, parking, rests, Snarsmon, Tolvmanstegen and Vindskydd Allemarken, but no official drinking-water category and no official campsite category for this stage.
No active official closure/deviation banner was found during the 2026-04-30 pass.
caveats: The WST GPX/API repeats coordinates heavily; de-duplicate consecutive duplicates before measuring or simplifying.
The official remote-stage warning for Stages 19-24 should be retained: sparse settlement, limited public transport, carry provisions and keep batteries charged.

generalRules: No direct protected-area camping/fire restriction was found intersecting the official GPX in the rules lane; general allemansrätten applies with normal limits.
Avoid camping near homes, in pastures/crops/plantations or where local signs restrict it.
Check Tanum and Strömstad fire bans on the day of travel. The 2026-04-30 no-fire-ban snapshot is volatile and should not be imported as static data.
Do not make fires on bare rock slabs, do not break/cut trees and do not use windfalls as firewood unless explicitly provided/allowed.
